clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind Keep, Count Remington Ridgewell tends a collection fit for a noble’s pride. A wealthy human in the House of Nobles, he gathers rare artifacts, heirlooms, and fine art.

Count Remington Ridgewell favors antiquities over military campaigns or local uprisings. His family’s personal museum holds jewelry and artifacts, and he spends his wealth gathering relics from fallen civilizations and houses across Azeroth. To fill his gallery, he finances adventurers and sends field agents such as Mayara Brightwing to retrieve rare objects from dangerous ruins, from Alterac’s mountain redoubts to the volcanic wastes of the Burning Steppes.
